lane: classifier architecture + executable Phase A semantic topology
forbidden_scope: live browser telemetry/background event collection/session tracking/user analytics

pipeline_contract.embedding_input: feature_views (semantic_view + role_view + structural_vector) derived only from canonical records

projection.phase: future Phase B; not executed by Phase A

pipeline_contract.cluster_identity: persistent cluster_id reconciled against previous accepted topology; membership_fingerprint_sha256 separately records exact membership
pipeline_contract.opportunity_intelligence: deterministic advisory scoring only; never mutates canonical prompt registry truth
pipeline_contract.disposability_test: delete artifacts/prompt-topology/topology.v1.json && python scripts/prompt-topology/run.py => byte-identical topology.v1.json for identical registry+config+previous-topology input

ordering_contract.cluster_order_within_family: sort by (-member_count, persistent cluster_id lexicographic); OUTLIER last. Exact membership is membership_fingerprint_sha256 and does not redefine a continuous cluster identity.
ordering_contract.role_rank: index in config.ordering.sprint_role_order; unlisted types sort after listed lexicographically
ordering_contract.centrality: mean composite similarity to all members of same cluster (higher first, integer micros in Phase A canonical artifact)
ordering_contract.final_tie_break: prompt_id lexicographic; guarantees strict total order and stability
ordering_contract.linear_order: historical design output remains future-compatible; Phase A canonical topology does not replace stable Prompt Kit sequence order
ordering_contract.source_vs_derived: canonical library order remains sequence_ascending per prompt-kit-order-navigation contract; topology is complementary recommendation/semantic metadata
determinism_guarantees: deterministic local hashing-vectorizer fixture/provider seam for Phase A CI
persist similarity/centrality/probability scores as integer micros where emitted by topology.v1.json
explicit deterministic PCA and HDBSCAN configuration
persistent cluster IDs reconciled against previous accepted topology with separate exact membership fingerprint
repeat build bytes == shuffled-source build bytes

artifacts.future_visualization_ready: historical projection-3d/shape design is retained for future Phase B/C but cannot influence Phase A semantic topology

afkaf_gate.flow: proposed prompt -> canonicalize -> compare vs current topology -> top neighbors + candidate family/cluster -> decision packet {STRENGTHEN|POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE|CREATE_NEW} -> only then may prompt_registry_ops allocate new ID

proof_ceiling: Executable repository/runtime Phase A proof: live-registry graph generation, multi-channel relationships, real HDBSCAN clustering/outliers, persistent cluster reconciliation, advisory opportunity scoring, canonical topology.v1.json, and repeat/shuffled-input byte determinism. Phase B 3D projection/spatial stability, Phase C viewer behavior, live telemetry, and production behavioral evidence remain unproven and out of scope.
